text: The stack is chosen -- AlwaysOn Availability Groups. This video draws the actual shape: SQLDBA01, SQLDBA02, cluster BrennanWSFC, Availability Group BrennanAG -- before any of it gets built.

Three names carry the design: BrennanWSFC, needing no shared storage; a cloud witness in Azure that breaks ties; and BrennanAGListener -- the one name the ERP application will ever be configured against.
Two node votes alone can tie one-to-one with no way to resolve it. A cloud witness isn't a third server -- it's one more vote in Azure Blob Storage, enough for a majority.

Replication runs synchronous-commit with automatic failover on both nodes -- every write confirmed on SQLDBA02 before the app hears back. The cost is latency; the payoff is a failure nobody has to wake up for.
The topology is settled. Next: the backup strategy this cluster still needs, including a real off-site copy in Azure.
